content.short: Heroic Story is a tabletop role-playing game with 12 character classes and an expanding free-to-roam world.
content.description: Heroic Story is a community-built and owned AAA game supported by backers including founders from Twitch, Polygon, and a16z. After securing a $6M investment in 2022, the team plans to build the game on a decentralized model where worlds that players and developers worldwide can contribute artifacts to sustain growth. More than 12k community members already hold whitelist spots for the game's release, signaling broad participation and strong anticipation.
